name: InfiniBand: High-Performance Network Interconnect
notes: InfiniBand provides high-bandwidth, low-latency networking for multi-node inference. Used by NIXL for KV cache transfer. Supports RDMA for direct GPU memory access. Key for disaggregated inference serving. | DEAD-LINK VERIFIED 2026-10-04.
